research_question: Is there any remaining atmospheric radiative information that is physically relevant to broadband SW_IN, genuinely independent of Stage8.1, causally available, available for all 347 benchmark origins, and potentially large enough to matter relative to ~36 W/m² MAE?

A_vertical_aerosol_structure_type.mechanism: Aerosol layer height, SSA, asymmetry parameter at sub-Arctic background AOD <0.05
A_vertical_aerosol_structure_type.causal_blocker: No 3D NRT aerosol LiDAR network covers Nuolja for 2024

B_vertical_water_vapor_structure.mechanism: Pressure broadening of near-IR H2O lines for fixed column TCWV
B_vertical_water_vapor_structure.redundancy_details: MEPS q(p) profile at 925, 850, 700, 500 hPa already present in Stage 8.1

C_total_column_ozone.mechanism: UV and Chappuis band absorption across 100 DU seasonal variation

D_rayleigh_molecular_scattering.physical_magnitude: Deterministically governed by surface pressure and solar zenith angle
D_rayleigh_molecular_scattering.derivability: 100% derivable from psfc and solar_elevation in Stage 8.1

E_minor_trace_gases.mechanism: Background CO2, CH4, N2O, O2 near-IR absorption
